I'll recheck the round-1 HIGH finding and the repair delta only, using the declared workflow files and probe evidence without a full review.Round 1 left one HIGH: private AzGuard VCS stays on the Composer path after staging. I’ll compare the current workflow filters and probe logs against that trigger.review: cursor/grok-4.7 GREEN

The round-1 HIGH is resolved. The repair does not add an in-scope defect. This is not a hosted CI result.

## Recheck scope

Round-1 finding only: after sealed-provider staging, the private AzGuard VCS stayed in the root and access repositories, the auth job re-added it, and Composer does not read `GH_TOKEN`. Checked against the repair in `.github/workflows/{ci,distribution-proof,remaining-cohort-proof}.yml`, `scripts/distribution/stage-stancl-providers.py` `register()`, `scripts/distribution/private-auth-proof.py`, `scripts/dependency-analyser.sh`, and the dict `repositories` in the root, access, and tenancy manifests.

Reused from round 1, not re-reviewed: SHA pins, permissions, `persist-credentials: false`, matrix, audit/validate, new jobs, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, and zizmor persona inputs. Deferred round-1 items stay outside P01.4, including `upgrade-proof` using `github.token` for public release lookups, local AzGuard trees in `install-profiles` / `upgrade-proof`, and the pre-existing package-test layout. DOD-21 in `dod-pre-existing.json` remains an O-3 live-CI blocker, not this repair. Secret provisioning and a hosted green run are still owner proof.

## Evidence

All 26 stage steps share one run block. It stages, then drops every repository whose URL is exactly `https://github.com/axiomasoft/azguard.git` from `composer.json`, `packages/access/composer.json`, and `packages/tenancy/composer.json`. Those three files are dict repositories. Root and access are the only manifests with that URL. Tenancy has only path repositories. The comprehension keeps the staged `file://` Composer repo and the other path repos. There is no `Register public AzGuard GitHub VCS` step and no `repositories.azguard` or `github-oauth` / `COMPOSER_AUTH` wiring. `auth-tests` now filters, then updates root and `packages/access`.

`stage-stancl-providers.py` `register()` only runs `composer config repositories.stancl-providers`. `dependency-analyser.sh` calls that same register for access and tenancy, then unsets `repositories.stancl-providers`. Neither writes the AzGuard VCS URL back. `GH_TOKEN` stays on the stage steps and on `dependencies` → `Analyse every standalone package`, both fail-closed with `${GH_TOKEN:?...}` before any command. No `run:` body contains a `${{` expression. Composer’s default `preferred-install` is `dist`, and the project does not override it, so the analyser’s `composer update` still takes the sealed zip.

`composer require --no-update` steps that still run before the filter pass an explicit constraint under `--no-interaction`. Composer’s `RequireCommand` returns before resolution, and `VcsRepository` does not contact the network until a package lookup. That is not the old update failure.

Probe `composer-no-oauth.json`, on detached `72ad98e`, ran the real stager and the workflow filter, then root and access `composer update --prefer-dist --no-interaction --no-progress` with an empty `COMPOSER_HOME` and no Composer auth. Both updates exited 0. Post-filter manifests report `private_vcs_urls: 0` and `sealed_provider_repository: true`. `composer_auth_files` is empty. Logs show `axioma-studio/azguard-core` and the stancl packages as `Extracting archive`, and access still locks `pestphp/pest`, with no clone. `token-precondition.json`: missing token exits 1 before staging; a synthetic token exits 0, removes only that VCS URL, and keeps the other repositories. `zizmor-final.log` and `zizmor-all-final.log` (zizmor 1.30.1, written after the workflow files) report no findings. `workflow-structure.json` matches the current jobs.
